sections.whatsHappening: You and the other parties must serve and file documents before certain events. At least 14 days before the settlement conference, serve and file any document you will rely on at trial, including an expert report, not attached to your claim or defence. Also, serve and file a list of proposed witnesses (Form 13A) and of other persons with knowledge of the matters in dispute. At least 30 days before the trial date, serve any document or written statement or an audio or visual record on all parties who were served with the notice of trial. This document shall be received in evidence unless the trial judge orders otherwise.
sections.whatToDoNext: Ensure you serve and file the required documents within the specified timeframes. Use personal service or an alternative method as allowed by the rules. Keep detailed notes of the service process for your affidavit of service.
sections.whatHappensAfter: Once you have served and filed the documents, they will be considered by the court. If you serve a document at least 30 days before the trial, it will be received in evidence unless the judge decides otherwise. If you wish to cross-examine a witness or author of a document served by another party, you may summon them as a witness.
